data: What is the value of the training data size (percentage of total data) at the vertical red line?

The red vertical line in the figure represents the stopping point for the Random models. The x-axis of the graph indicates the training data size (percentage of total data). By examining the position of the red vertical line on the x-axis, we can determine the value of the training data size at this point. The red vertical line appears to be positioned at approximately 60% on the x-axis. Therefore, the value of the training data size at the vertical red line is around 60%.
